SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can effective sign reading be done? 2. How can key points be identified in a text?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: Learners develop digital citizenship skills as they search online for information on note-making.

● Learning to learn: As learners organise their own learning and make notes after reading varied texts.

Values:

Link to other Subjects
